items.label: Long-Termism
items.value: For this puffer bag, we started with the concept of "Long-Termism". We hope that each accessory can be cherished and experienced over and over again, continuing the cycle of daily wear and becoming a companion that is always as good as new.

items.label: Ultra-Light & Soft
items.value: It's crafted from polyester memory fabric in the pillowy texture and with a fresh revitalizing color tone. Lined with stuffing but weighs only 1.1 lbs for a cloud-like feeling. Perfect for work, gym, college, dating, shopping, travel, beach, weekend.

items.label: Chic Design
items.value: Stand out with chic macaron color options—soft pastels and vibrant hues elevate casual outfits while keeping your look modern, fresh and trendy. Also a great gift to teachers, mommy, nurses, girlfriend for birthdays, Valentine's Day, Christmas, anniversaries, Mother's Day, New Year, etc.

items.label: Smart Organization
items.value: 16" x 6" x 12", capacity 20L. This quilted utility shoulder bag holds everything in its place with 9 pockets (4 exterior + 5 interior), including a padded laptop sleeve (fits up to 15"), quick-access phone/keys slots, and a matching makeup pouch for your lipstick, suncream and other small items.

items.label: Warm Tips
items.value: Machine washable, air dry. Do not tumble dry and iron. To reduce our carbon footprint, the bags ship in compact folded packaging. When you receive the item, it may have some wrinkles, but after a few days it will return to its original shape.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Machine Wash, Air Dry. Do Not Tumble Dry or Iron.
